ledger.x: 1814: the Storting elects Charles XIII King of Norway and the union with Sweden begins.
1814: Norway comes under the Swedish crown.

wars.name: Swedish-Norwegian War (1814)
wars.outcome: The Swedish invasion of 29 July 1814 ended with the Convention of Moss on 14 August 1814, a general ceasefire based effectively on peace terms; the Storting accepted the union on 4 November 1814.

certainty.note: The union kept the earlier frontiers of the two kingdoms and Finland's loss to Russia (1809) fixed the eastern one; the page names no survey and dates only the 1905 neutral zone (Karlstad agreement).
